title: ATS Hiring-Signal Tracker Input
description: Give target companies, get each one's live hiring signal from Greenhouse + Lever. Pay per resolved company.

companies.title: Target companies
companies.description: Company names or ATS tokens to check. A name is slugified to guess the token; for an exact match pass 'greenhouse:token' or 'lever:token' (the token is the slug in the careers URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/TOKEN).

hotMinRoles.title: Hot account threshold (open roles)
hotMinRoles.description: A company with at least this many open roles and a posting in the last 30 days is tiered hot_account.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies
maxCompanies.description: Cap how many companies are checked per run.
